purpose: Teach: ガーデニング/セーフ/ニヤニヤ/エレガント/お決まり/打てる/アシ/小さかっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 退職後、ガーデニング、私の新しい趣味になったな。
lines.en: Gardening became my new hobby after I retired.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective opening. Soft warmth on the word 'became.' Slow, wandering pace like he's watching something grow. Trails off slightly, content in the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。あの時、間に合ってセーフだったわね、新幹線。
lines.en: Yes. We made it just in time on that shinkansen trip.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Small smile in the voice—remembering a narrow escape. Nostalgic, unhurried rhythm. Soft exhale on the word 'time.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫の顔見ると、自然に、ニヤニヤしちゃうな、私。
lines.en: When I see my grandkid's face, I can't help but smile.
lines.style: Warm, slightly embarrassed chuckle underlying the words. Tender admission without apology. Gentle, unguarded delivery. Tender warmth on 'grandkid's face.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃の私、エレガントだったかしらね、あなたから見て。
lines.en: I wonder if you thought I was elegant back when I was young.
lines.style: Uncertain, probing softly. Looking for reassurance without demanding it. Slight lift at the end—curious and vulnerable. Patient pause before 'elegant.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お決まりの散歩コース、毎日、安心するな。
lines.en: Our usual walking route every day—it's become comforting.
lines.style: Measured, grounded tone. Quiet satisfaction on 'usual.' Steady rhythm like the walk itself. Matter-of-fact warmth—not overstated, just true.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫、野球で、ホームラン、打てるって自慢してたわよ。
lines.en: Our grandson was bragging about hitting a homerun in baseball.
lines.style: Light, proud amusement in the voice. Slight lift on 'homerun'—sharing in his pride. Warm and lively, but not loud. Gentle humor underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、地域の世話人として、アシスタント役、よくやったな。
lines.en: Back when I was young, I did a lot of community volunteer work as an assistant.
lines.style: Quietly reflective, acknowledging past effort without needing recognition. Measured, thoughtful cadence. Slight emphasis on 'community'—it mattered. Humble understatement.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 息子、子供の頃、本当に体が小さかったわね、覚えてる?
lines.en: Do you remember how small our son was as a child?
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Gentle probe into shared memory. Nostalgic and tender. Slight smile on 'small'—that's part of the charm. Trailing question, inviting him to remember with her.
